programmes.name_local: Délégation générale à l'Entrepreneuriat Rapide des Femmes et des Jeunes (DER/FJ)
programmes.name_en: Délégation générale à l'Entrepreneuriat Rapide des Femmes et des Jeunes (DER/FJ)
programmes.funder: DER/FJ, Présidence de la République du Sénégal
programmes.amount_note: DER/FJ provides tiered financing from micro-credits of a few hundred thousand CFA francs up to tens of millions of CFA francs for structured SMEs, plus dedicated startup windows (including a digital/tech window) and guarantee products.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications through the DER/FJ platform, with periodic themed calls (agriculture, digital, women's entrepreneurship).
programmes.reopen_note: DER/FJ regularly launches themed windows alongside its permanent products; announcements are made on der.sn and its social channels.

procedure_steps.detail: Create an account on the DER/FJ platform.
Select the financing window matching your profile.
Submit the project with financial projections.
Assessment and financing agreement, often via a partner financial institution.

eligibility.other_note: Targets Senegalese women and young people (broadly under 40); some windows accept unregistered micro-entrepreneurs, others require formal registration.
